itep_2018_2022.unit: percent (average effective federal income tax rate)
itep_2018_2022.note: ITEP (Feb 29, 2024): 342 large corporations profitable in every year 2018-2022 paid an average effective federal income tax rate of 14.1% (vs 21% statutory); 87 paid single-digit or lower rates, 55 under 5%; 23 paid zero over the 5 years. gao_2018.unit: percent (average effective federal income tax rate)
gao_2018.note: GAO-23-105384 (published Dec 14, 2022; released Jan 13, 2023): average effective rate for profitable large corporations (Schedule M-3 filers, assets >= $10M) fell from 16% in 2014 to 9% in 2018 (first TCJA year); on average 25% of profitable large corporations had no tax liability. Tax liability as a share of income (IRS data).
